text:
Marta: Heads up — marketplace May wave: labs are constrained. We need to pick which SKUs get canary priority (H100 / H200 / B200 / MI300 / Gaudi). Short list proposals please.

Sanjay: Recommendation: H100 + Gaudi as our low-latency canaries (US-west), MI300 for EU compute-heavy customers. H200/B200 can be secondary/backfill.

Laura: Lab numbers: us-west nodes=5 (usable), apac nodes=3, eu nodes=9 but 6 blocked until next Tue. If H100 requires 8x config, we're short.

Kevin: Vendors asked for an official canary SKU list today so they can schedule signoffs. We should avoid flipping after we notify them.

Marta: Proposed commit: H100 (US-west limited canary), Gaudi (US-west), MI300 (EU after Tue), H200 (APAC small canary), B200 (post-wave). This preserves perf SLAs and gives EU time for infra tests.

Laura: Ops caveat: to hit that we need to reduce H100 per-node density to 5x initially and do a progressive step-up. Will create staggered manifests.

Sanjay: Also ensure 2 reserved nodes in us-west for rapid repro/fallback. If H100 kernel regressions happen, we fall back to H200 images on those nodes.

Marta: Action items:
- Laura: make canary manifests and rollout plan (5x -> 10x).
- Sanjay: reserve 2 fallback nodes in us-west, draft rollback triggers (latency P95 > baseline +20% OR error rate > 1%).
- Kevin: send vendor note with SKU list + compatibility matrix request and ask for driver build ETA by EOD.

Laura: Example manifest patch I will use:
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: gpu-canary
  namespace: marketplace-canary
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        canary-density: "5x"
```

InfraBot: Scheduled pre-smoke run at 2026-05-03T14:00Z; will post results to #eng-oncall.

Kevin: I'll draft the vendor email now. Will include a requested driver/firmware ETA + test vectors.

Sanjay: Please include kernel build tags, quantization/precision tiers (FP16/INT8), and max-seq-length expectations in the compatibility matrix. That reduces back-and-forth during incident triage.

Marta: Good call. Laura/Sanjay — add a one-pager compatibility matrix to the canary PR. Kevin — include it in the vendor ask.

Laura: Can do. Checklist on the PR will include: smoke tests, perf baselines, regression thresholds, kernel-driver pairs.

Kevin: Vendors will likely need a 24h signoff window; I'll call that out and request any known firmware blockers up front.

Marta: Timeline (tentative): US-west canaries start 2026-05-04 09:00 PT, EU MI300 start 2026-05-06 08:00 UTC (post infra unblock), APAC H200 window 2026-05-08. We'll shift if vendors push back.

Sanjay: One last note — collect SKUs' expected power/thermal derate notes in case we hit capacity on BMC throttles. Attach to vendor note.

Marta: OK. If no objections by 12:00 PT we'll lock the list and notify partners. :thumbsup:
